sql: SELECT 'verification_token' T, COUNT(*) FROM VERIFICATION_TOKEN WHERE USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM USER_ACCOUNT) UNION ALL SELECT 'users_roles', COUNT(*) FROM USERS_ROLES WHERE USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM USER_ACCOUNT) OR ROLE_ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM ROLE) UNION ALL SELECT 'roles_privileges', COUNT(*) FROM ROLES_PRIVILEGES WHERE ROLE_ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM ROLE) OR PRIVILEGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM PRIVILEGE) UNION ALL SELECT 'user_location', COUNT(*) FROM USER_LOCATION UNION ALL SELECT 'new_location_token', COUNT(*) FROM NEW_LOCATION_TOKEN UNION ALL SELECT 'device_metadata', COUNT(*) FROM DEVICE_METADATA
